name: guided_hole_centred_too_narrow
why: Z-C21.10, finding N50 (lot Z-C21.2). foro_guidato reads its anchors before the ISO table decides the diameter, so LeggiAncora runs with a zero half-width and its rule «the profile fits between the two edges» never fires; ScavalcaColRaggio, which repeats the check once the hole exists, skipped centred axes on purpose (`!asse.Centrata`) and only looked at distanza_mm. An M8 clearance hole (Ø9) centred between the two edges of a rib 6 mm wide was confirmed, and it cut through both walls of the rib. The same request on taglio_cilindrico is refused with «non ci sta». Now the centred axes are checked too, half the gap against the radius, before the anchor is applied, and the hole is removed.
defect_caught: Step 4 asks for an M8 clearance hole centred between the two long edges of the rib top, 6 mm apart: it must be refused on its size and leave the part as it was. On library 0.140.0 it is RED: the hole is made and the anchor is attempted on edges the hole has just cut (confirmed, or refused for another reason and with another message). Step 3 is the twin: an M4 (Ø4.5) centred between the same two edges fits, and must still be made, anchored and fully defined, so the new check is not a check that refuses every centred hole.
_and_the_twin_is_in_the_same_file: Step 4 and step 3 are the same operation on the same face, between the same two edges, and differ by the size of the screw (M8 instead of M4) and by the position along the rib.
_the_numbers: Plate 200 x 120 x 20 = 480000. Rib 160 x 6 x 20 on the front face: + 19200, total 499200; its top is at z = 40 and its long edges at y = -3 and y = +3, so the gap is 6 and half of it 3. ISO 273 medium clearance (the table of foro_guidato, M8 -> 9 in `hole_wizard_follows_the_table`): M4 -> Ø4.5, radius 2.25 < 3, it fits; M8 -> Ø9, radius 4.5 > 3, it does not fit. The M4 is through all from the rib top: rib 20 + plate 20 = 40 mm, pi x 2.25^2 x 40 = 636.17, so 499200 - 636.17 = 498563.83. Its centre is 30 from the rib end at x = 80 (x = 50), and 30 from the other end at x = -80 for the refused M8 (x = -50).

expect.tolerance_why: 480000 plus 160*6*20, read back from the mass properties
the diameter is read in metres from the hole definition
expect.why: the size the fit check uses: radius 2.25 against half the gap, 3

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 499200 minus pi x 2.25^2 x 40
the axis of the cylinder is read in metres
as above: halfway between y = -3 and y = +3

expect.why: the centred anchor was applied: the new fit check lets a hole that fits go through
